Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body: Is Flight  just a keyword for other cards or is there more to a vampire that has Flight?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Trigger wrote:
> Is Flight  just a keyword for other cards or is there more to a vampire that has Flight?
>
Just a keyword. It's sort of like a discipline, except it's not a discipline. Vampires with flight don't have magic innate powers, except as provided by card text.

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body: as a point of order, i wish  and  were black icons on white backgrounds like Flight. it'd certainly remove a lot of the confusion for things, because they wouldn't look like disciplines. it'd also open up an avenue for other such non-discipline abilities.
